core_obligations: Verify the two claims on the class E: (a) every abelian sheaf on Y_etale embeds into a product of skyscraper sheaves via the Godement step, injective by exactness of stalks; (b) state the representability requirement for Hom(f_!F, G) on E and note the dual partially defined adjoint lemma then produces f^! (proof lines 2388-2408).

Prove (b) and (2): decompose Hom against a product of skyscrapers into a product of Homs, reduce to a single skyscraper ȳ_*A, compute both sides with the stalk description of f_!, and identify the representing object as the product of x̄_*A over the fibre (proof lines 2411-2444).

Prove (3): observe that a Lambda-module is an abelian sheaf with a map Lambda -> End, transport the adjunction from (1), and note the module-level adjoint agrees with f^! on underlying abelian sheaves (proof lines 2447-2451).
proof_roadmap: Class E, embedding claim, and the adjoint production lemma (proof lines 2388-2408).
Representability on skyscrapers and the value of f^! (proof lines 2411-2444).
Module version by endomorphism transport (proof lines 2447-2451).
